source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "digital infrastructure" AND (politics OR power OR sociotechnical OR "science and technology studies")
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"digital infrastructure" AND (politics OR power OR sociotechnical OR "science and technology studies"),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("digital infrastructure" AND ("science and technology studies" OR "politics" OR "power" OR "sociotechnical"))
